model: Seiko Pilot's Flight SNA411P1 on a black/red NATO strap (SKU SNA411P1-VAR-NATO3)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = dial centre. Plan sizes from the straightened turned photo (42 mm coin-edge bezel, Irsyad); heights fitted to the listed 13 mm. Dial, subdials with their hands, date and the slide-rule bezel insert come from one photo map; the strap from a straightened atlas of the photo's strap.

crown.note: short wide fluted crown with a rounded end, from the turned photo (6.0 mm across, 3.45 mm out of the case)

pushers.note: screw-down fluted collar at the case, then a plain button with a domed end (turned photo)

lug.note: 6 o'clock lug of the straightened photo (inner 11.2, outer 14.5 mm, tip 23.17 mm), mirrored to all four

strap.note: NATO 22 mm; house curl (SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R; built at final depth

lume.note: light grey lume as in the photo

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission; black base colour keeps the black dial clear (SRPG18J1)
